stemMd: Which statement cannot be true in any permitted order?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Pearl and Opal must occupy consecutive positions, in either order.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Pearl and Opal must not occupy consecutive positions.

explanationMd:
Test whether each proposed statement can be added consistently to the rules. "Jade must be in position 1." is incompatible with every permitted order. The alternative statements each have a complete valid example, given in their feedback. To check impossibility, enumerate placements for the most restricted item or block, then remove every case breaking a rule.

Complete permitted orders (each arrow advances one position):
- Amber → Pearl → Jade → Coral → Opal
- Amber → Pearl → Jade → Opal → Coral
- Opal → Amber → Pearl → Jade → Coral
- Opal → Jade → Amber → Pearl → Coral
- Opal → Jade → Coral → Amber → Pearl
- Opal → Jade → Coral → Pearl → Amber
- Opal → Jade → Pearl → Amber → Coral
- Opal → Pearl → Amber → Jade → Coral
- Pearl → Amber → Jade → Coral → Opal
- Pearl → Amber → Jade → Opal → Coral

distractorRationale.b: This is possible, as demonstrated by Amber → Pearl → Jade → Coral → Opal, which obeys all the original conditions.
distractorRationale.d: This is possible, as demonstrated by Amber → Pearl → Jade → Coral → Opal, which obeys all the original conditions.
distractorRationale.a: This is possible, as demonstrated by Opal → Pearl → Amber → Jade → Coral, which obeys all the original conditions.

Opal must not be in position 3. leave 10 valid orders: Amber>Pearl>Jade>Coral>Opal; Amber>Pearl>Jade>Opal>Coral; Opal>Amber>Pearl>Jade>Coral; Opal>Jade>Amber>Pearl>Coral; Opal>Jade>Coral>Amber>Pearl; Opal>Jade>Coral>Pearl>Amber; Opal>Jade>Pearl>Amber>Coral; Opal>Pearl>Amber>Jade>Coral; Pearl>Amber>Jade>Coral>Opal; Pearl>Amber>Jade>Opal>Coral. Choice true counts: a=9, b=0, c=4, d=1; impossible requires zero matches.
